links.outcome: Error types in LLM answers to DILI questions, including omissions and hallucinations
links.effect: Omission of crucial information accounted for 72% of errors, predominantly in GPT-3.5-Turbo; hallucinations rare (<10%) but notable in LLaMA outputs.
links.quote: Error analysis showed that omission of crucial information accounted for 72% of errors, predominantly in GPT-3.5-Turbo, whereas hallucinations were rare (<10%) but notable in LLaMA outputs.

screen.reason: Evaluates several LLMs on a curated benchmark of 28 questions related to drug-induced liver injury without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
